text:
Marcel Anders: Quick thought  office fika (coffee + cinnamon buns) at 4pm, then optional 6pm mini-golf challenge at Par-3 around the corner? low key prizes like best trick shot. :coffee::golf:
Priya Rao: love a fika. is cinnamon bun mandatory? asking for a friend.
Marcel Anders: strongly encouraged. i'll bring a batch from the bakery.
Eden Cho: mini-golf sounds fun. do we do teams or free-for-all?
Liam O'Connor: teams of two? keeps it friendly and fast.
Priya Rao: can someone check if Par-3 takes groups of 6 without reservation?
Marcel Anders: i'll call. also quick poll  react :coffee: for fika only, :golf: for both, :shrug: if maybe.
Eden Cho: :golf:
Liam O'Connor: :golf:
Priya Rao: :coffee: (might join after work)
Marcel Anders: RSVP list so far: Marcel, Priya (maybe), Eden, Liam. bring guests allowed but mark in RSVP.
Liam O'Connor: any accessibility notes for Par-3? stairs?
Marcel Anders: Par-3 has one small step but most holes are flat; i can call and confirm ramp access.
Priya Rao: also heads-up: allergic to nuts. please label pastries?
Marcel Anders: will label and include a nut-free batch.
Priya Rao: thanks!
